confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from 2026 and undated third-party sources for the Netherlands and Rotterdam, converted at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.17 from general knowledge (not searched). Beer and cocktail figures are weakly sourced: beer comes from beach-bar surveys and cocktail from an Expatistan club estimate. The wine glass anchor is inferred from beer prices and wholesale glass-price ranges. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no accommodation listings or booking pages were checked. The RBA FX observation could not be verified: search results showed RBA exchange-rate values from March 2026 without dates, so as_of_date and source_rate are null and should not be used until confirmed on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized Dutch port city, using Rotterdam-specific cocktail and cappuccino figures where available and national Dutch price ranges elsewhere. Accommodation is benchmarked to other mid-sized Western European cities with similar July tourism demand.
